```{python}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import plotly.express as px

import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv

from entsoe import EntsoePandasClient
```





```{python}
load_dotenv()

def entsoe_client():
    '''
    Create and return ENTSO-E API client.
    '''
    entsoe_token = os.getenv("ENTSOE_API_TOKEN")

    if entsoe_token is None:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "ENTSOE_API_TOKEN is required"
        )

    return EntsoePandasClient(api_key=entsoe_token)

client = entsoe_client()
```

```{python}
def get_periods(timezone):

    now = pd.Timestamp.now(tz=timezone)
    today = now.normalize()

    return {
        "now": now,
        "today": today,
        "yesterday": today - pd.Timedelta(days=1),
        "last_week": today - pd.Timedelta(days=7),
        "last_month": today - pd.DateOffset(months=1),
        "tomorrow": today + pd.Timedelta(days=1),
        "day_after_tomorrow": today + pd.Timedelta(days=2),
        "next_week": today + pd.Timedelta(days=7),
        "next_month": today + pd.DateOffset(months=1),
    }
```



::: {.panel-tabset}

# Load
```{python}

# | out-width: 100%

def show_load(country):

    config = countries[country]

    country_code = config["code"]

    timezone = config["timezone"]
    periods = get_periods(timezone)

    load = client.query_load(
        country_code=config["code"],
        start=periods["last_week"],
        end=periods["now"],
    )
    fig = px.line(
        load,
        title=f"{country} — Actual Load",
        labels={
            "index": "Time",
            "value": "Load (MW)",
            "variable": ""
        }
    )

    fig.update_layout(
        xaxis_title="Time",
        yaxis_title="Load (MW)",
        legend=dict(
            orientation="h"
        ),
    )

    fig.show()
```
